title: Hidden Directory Listing Failure in LS Tool Compared to Bash ls
body:
**Bug Description**
It appears that when Claude uses its internal LS tool wrapper it is unable to list contents of hidden directories (starting with .).  When instructed to instead use the standard `ls` command directly, it functions correctly.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 0.2.53
- Feedback ID: 21a8bb82-9980-41f9-bcfd-b47fa5f235c5
author: lkingland

top_comments.author: ollie-anthropic
top_comments.body: Hey all, hidden files should be available now for searching in the latest release (v1.0.64) :)

top_comments.author: burchbobby
top_comments.body: Relatedly, I notice that when I use the @ command to import a file, files within hidden directories are not included. I have become partial to creating an .ai directory to store agent context and directives, as well as project planning documentation. Claude Code does not seem to see these files nor is it able to interact with them.

top_comments.author: jakswa
top_comments.body: This one is getting pretty annoying for me. Might be time for a all-time CLAUDE.md way up high that is always ingested...
